newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt yields weaken, focus on U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt yields weaken, focus on U.S. data.

text.p: Swedish short term debt yields inched up a touch on Monday, mirroring a move in long yields on Friday.
"It's an effect from Friday. The weaker crown and the rise in the yields did not have full effect on the short end on Friday and are making up for that," a dealer said.
The National Debt Office will issue seven billion crowns in one year T-bills on Tuesday.
Dealers consider this risky considering the weak crown and the fact that the Sedish market will be closed for half a day on Wednesday and all day Thursday.
